Select your level of study below to access the Online Application Form.

Applicants to the University of Sopron's English-taught BA/BSc programs must provide the following documents: Secondary School Certificate (English/German copy) Valid Passport Copy Proof of English Proficiency: B2 level or higher (TOEFL, IELTS, Cambridge, Oxford). Native speakers or those with a "Medium of Instruction" certificate are exempt. Application Fee Receipt Optional: CV, Motivation Letter, or Letters of Recommendation.
Please ensure all documents are in English or German. If they are in another language, a certified translation must be attached.
Language requirements: at least CEFR B2 level (or equivalent TOEFL or IELTS Academic) proficiency in English.
Proof of English Proficiency: B2 level or higher (TOEFL, IELTS, Cambridge, Oxford).
